role: Runbook for GDPR/CCPA deletion and access requests: explains there is no backend, directs users to the in-app Delete All My Data flow (local + CloudKit zone deletion) and Export Data, and gives a reply template.

units.does: no behavioural claim: legal response windows (GDPR 30 days, CCPA 45+45) and HIPAA non-applicability.

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Architecture you're working with
units.does: Claims: no backend; CloudKit private DB holds session backups, raw RR archives and workout tracks; iCloud sign-out or erasing the device does not delete them; Delete All My Data removes the cloud copy; AI API keys are ThisDeviceOnly; archive encryption key is not synchronizable; CloudPayloadCodec key and EntitlementAnchor are synchronizable. Verified: APIKeyStore uses kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly (APIKeyStore.swift), EncryptionManager uses AfterFirstUnlock without synchronizable (Storage/EncryptionManager.swift), CloudPayloadCodec.swift and EntitlementAnchor.swift set kSecAttrSynchronizable true; workout GPS tracks travel inside the HRVSession payload.

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 1 — Understand what you can and cannot do
units.does: Claims no account system, so nothing to verify; the Profile email field is a report recipient. No code contradiction found.

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 2 — Local data deletion
units.does: Claims More → Settings → Advanced Data Controls → Delete All My Data, typing DELETE MY DATA, calls DataPurgeService.purgeAllUserData, which holds PurgeGate (beginPurge/endPurge: no archive write or upload while it runs) and sets iCloudSyncEnabled false before deleting anything, then wipes archive, raw backups, CloudKit sync state, API keys, conversations, user facts, disclaimer flags, the settings profile (reset and read back from disk), the personal HRV baseline (disk and memory), debug/crash logs, units preference, breadcrumbs, legacy widget keys (sweepAllDefaults) and sweeps containers/preferences with a keep-list; keeps Health samples and the purchase/trial anchor; points out that deleting a session forever from the Trash removes its Apple Health exports (SessionRecoveryCoordinator.permanentlyDelete → HealthWriteAndObserve.removeExports). Says the delete is unavailable while a recording is in progress or a reading awaits acceptance, and that a recording started during the iCloud delete stops it before the local wipe with sync left off (Refusal.recordingStartedDuringDelete).

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 3 — CloudKit private-DB deletion
units.does: Claims the purge awaits CloudKitSyncManager.deleteAllRemoteData, which deletes zones HRVSessions and UserSettings before the local wipe (after PurgeGate closes and sync is turned off); the zones are deleted only in the account synced with, or with none recorded the signed-in one unless sync was stopped for a different account, else nothing is deleted and failure reported (mayDeleteInSignedInAccount); other devices on the account are not wiped: each finds the zones gone, CloudAccountGuard.zoneWasDeleted → stopSync turns its sync off with a notice, keeps local data and uploads nothing, so the user runs the delete on each; offline/signed-out failure still completes the local wipe and reports remoteDeleted false, surfaced as a retry prompt; re-running is idempotent (zone-already-gone counts as success, 30 s timeout, Report.remoteLine).

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 4 — Third-party AI provider data
units.does: Claims providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, DeepSeek) retain content and the user enabled them per ProviderConsentTracker's consent log. Provider files exist (AnthropicProvider, OpenAIProvider, GeminiProvider, GrokProvider, DeepSeekProvider).

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 5 — Data export (Article 15 / 20)
units.does: Claims More → Settings → iCloud & Data → Import & Export → Export Data offers RR CSV, summary CSV and all-sessions JSON. Verified: SettingsPages+Data.swift/252 Import & Export → ExportDataView with 'Export RR Intervals (CSV)', 'Export Summary (CSV)', 'Export All Sessions (JSON)' (ExportAndArchiveViews.swift).

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 6 — Reply template
units.does: Reply template repeating the in-app deletion steps, the iCloud sign-out warning and the export path; consistent with Step 2/3/5 claims.

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Step 7 — Log the request
units.does: no behavioural claim: keep a private log outside the repo for 3 years.

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Edge cases
units.does: no behavioural claim: guidance for account-takeover suspicion, minors, deceased users.

units.key: § Runbook: GDPR / CCPA Data-Deletion Request > Compliance posture (for your records)
units.does: Claims nothing health-related remains in the app after delete-all; Apple Health samples remain. Consistent with DataPurgeService sweep design and footerLines note.
